title: X is nudging users to promote their posts with a pointing hand, and people are confused

claims.claim: Son 24 saat içinde, birçok kullanıcı yazı yazarken promote butonunu gösteren gizli bir el işaretinin çıktığını paylaştı.

evidence.quote: Over the last 24 hours, a growing number of users have posted that a mysterious hand pointing to the “promote” button suddenly showed up while they were writing a post.

claims.claim: TBPN podcast başkanı Dylan Abruscato, bu etkileşim hilesini Nikita Bier ile ilişkilendirdi.

evidence.quote: TBPN podcast’s president Dylan Abruscato said that this engagement trick was the “most Nikita-coded thing I’ve ever seen,” a nod to the growth tactics associated with Nikita Bier, X’s former head of product.

claims.claim: Nikita Bier, X'in eski ürün başkanıdır.

evidence.quote: Nikita Bier, X’s former head of product.
a nod to the growth tactics associated with Nikita Bier, X’s former head of product.

claims.claim: Nikita Bier Ağustos ayında platformdan ayrıldı.

evidence.quote: Bier left the platform in August after almost a year at the helm.

claims.claim: Peter Sellis, X'in yeni ürün şefi olarak görevi devraldı.

evidence.quote: Peter Sellis, posted that he has taken over as X’s product chief.
On Monday, Bier’s former boss and ex-head of product for Snap and Discord, Peter Sellis, posted that he has taken over as X’s product chief.

claims.claim: Peter Sellis, X'in eski ürün başkanı Bier'in eski yöneticisidir ve Snap ile Discord'un eski ürün başkanıdır.

evidence.quote: On Monday, Bier’s former boss and ex-head of product for Snap and Discord, Peter Sellis, posted that he has taken over as X’s product chief.
